gatoh.graphs.graphs.Graph.change_generation_params

Graph.change_generation_params(**params) → None[source]

Setter function which outlines the existing generation parameters used in generate_graph() and allows the user to alter them.

Parameters:

  • p (float, optional) – The probability of edge rewiring (small-world) or edge creation (random).

  • m (int, optional) – The number of nearest neighbours that each node is connected to initially (scale-free).

Param:

sbm_sizes: The size of generated blocks (blockmodel).

Raises:

UserWarning – If invalid parameter keys or data types are input to the function.
